## UseGatewayHttps {#Sisk_Ssl_SslProxy_UseGatewayHttps}

Gets or sets whether the [SslProxy](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Ssl.SslProxy.md) should use HTTPS for the gateway
connection or plain HTTP.

public bool UseGatewayHttps { get; set; }
